sourceInformation.perspective: First-person operating field; staged third-person story scenes
sourceInformation.tech: my-3dge 6a1501f, three.js 0.182.0 WebGPU, Rapier 0.21.0, TypeScript 5.9.3, Vite 7.3.7, AI Hub Session Protocol v1 client 1.4.0
sourceInformation.artDirection: Original procedural Harbor Light hospital: sea-glass teal, brass and rain blue; glossy stylized tissue; native engine geometry and puppets
sourceInformation.animation: Native humanoid and multi-beat action animator, blob rigs, live tissue and instrument geometry
sourceInformation.audio: Original synthesized adaptive music, instrument effects, ECG and offline-rendered formant gibberish voices; music defaults to 10%
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub shared-world sessions only; 1–4 local surgeons in couch co-op on one screen
sourceInformation.testing: Headless deterministic simulation, bot playthroughs, replay hashes, browser interaction and AI Hub harness; no review agents. Physical controllers, audio listening, TV and real iOS Safari unavailable.
sourceInformation.research: Supplied PLAN.md research; upstream my-3dge workspace and public API; AI Hub Session Protocol v1 documentation.

engineFeedback: The deterministic headless core and readable procedural geometry make surgical rules and presentation separable.

aiHub.name: Trauma Coast: Second Sight
aiHub.tagline: The night shift has a pulse.
aiHub.description: Eight operations in a storm-struck harbor hospital. Cut, stitch and fight the soothingly named parasites in miracle grafts, alone or with up to four surgeons.
aiHub.controls: Stick or mouse aims · R2 or click uses the tool · right stick or 1–8 picks a tool
